Description: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Changelog:
In the /hdebug Sources tab, hovering a repo now shows a list of every plugin it offers. The ones you have installed are listed first and highlighted, so it is easy to see what a repo is actually giving you before you remove it.

Notifications on the right side of the screen now always stay on top, so clicking another window no longer hides them.
